## C {#c .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  Abbreviation   Meaning                                       Explanation
  -------------- --------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CA (1)         Certification Authority                        
  CA (2)         Controller Application (Isobus/J1939)          
  CAL            CAN Application layer                         CAL forms the application layer in the protocol hierarchy of the CAN bus
  CAN            Controller Area Network                       Standardized (ISO 11898) automotive communication interface between control units
  CAN FD         CAN Flexible Datarate                          
  CarPU          Car Processing Unit                            
  CB / CB-ME     Rexroth Bootloader Software Customer-block    Customer relevant part of the flashbootloader
  CFI            BOSCH CarPU Flash Interface                    
  CiA            CAN in Automation                             CiA organization is the international association of users and manufacturers of CAN-based communication protocols.
  CLAPI          Customer Loader API                            
  CLCC           Closed Loop Current Control                    
  CM (1)         Current Measurement                           A method of the power output current feedback. The current measured  during both ON and OFF phase of PWM or digital state. This method provides a high performance of the current feedback.
  CM (2)         Connection Mode (Isobus/J1939)                 
  CMAC           Cipher-Based Message Authentication Code      Cipher-Based Message Authentication Code is a cryptographic technique used to ensure the integrity and authenticity of messages in cybersecurity.
  CMDT           Connection Mode Data Transfer                  
  CPU            Central Processing Unit                        
  CRC            Cyclic Redundancy Check                        
  CS (1)         Current Sensing                               A method of the power output current feedback. The current measured only during ON phase of PWM or digital state.  This method is less performance compare to Current Measurement(CM).
  CS (2)         Chip Select (in Microcontroller)              Chip Select is a control signal used to enable or disable a specific integrated circuit on the bus.
  CSAI           Cryptographic Service Application Interface    
  CTS            Clear To Send

## E {#e .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  Abbreviation    Meaning                                      Explanation
  --------------- -------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  eC              easyConfig tool                               
  ECC             Error correcting code                         
  ECU             Electronic Control Unit                      e.g., the Rexroth RC40 control unit
  EDC             Error Detection Code                         Error Detection Code is a code added to a block of data to detect, but not correct, errors that may have occurred during transmission or storage.
  EDS             Electronic data sheets                        
  EMCY            Emergency                                    A service, which signals internal fatal device errors to inform other CANopen devices in the network.
  EOF             End-Of-Frame                                 Section of CAN 2.0B / CAN-FD, this section will tell the end of the frame
  EOL             End of Line                                  Final stage of production assembly line (e.g., of an ECU or vehicle), typically includes final flashing, calibration and testing.
  ETP             Extended Transport Protocol (Isobus/J1939)

| FTB                   | Failure Type Byte                              | FTB is defined as the Failure Type Byte in extended DTCs most commonly used in CAN networks. ## I {#i .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  Abbreviation   Meaning                                    Explanation
  -------------- ------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  \-             Ignition Phase                             Time from which the RC is activated (e.g., by the ignition signal or CAN wake-up) until the RC is deactivated after the ignition is switched off and the after-run functions have been completed.

  ID             Identifier                                  
  IOCBI          InputOutputControlByIdentifier             UDS Service Input Output Control By Identifier. UDS Service ID: 0x2F
  IoT            Internet of Things

  ISR            Interrupt Service Routine                  A software routine that is invoked by hardware when an interrupt occurs.
  IP             Internet Protocol                           

  ------- -------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  IOCBI   InputOutputControlByIdentifier         Specifies the InputOutput Control functional unit.
  I-PDU   Interaction Layer Protocol Data Unit   a collection of messages transmitted between nodes in a network.

  ISR     Interrupt Service Routine              ISR handles interrupts by temporarily pausing main program execution.
  ------- -------------------------------------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------

## T {#t .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  Abbreviation   Meaning                         Explanation
  -------------- ------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  \-             Total service life              Time from delivery to decommissioning of the machine.
  TRNG           True Random Number Generator     
  TCP            Transmission Control Protocol   TCP is one of the protocols of the Internet protocol(IP). TCP provides reliable, ordered, and error-checked delivery of a stream of octets (bytes) between applications running on hosts communicating via an IP network.

## U {#u .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  Abbreviation   Meaning                       Explanation
  -------------- ----------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UDS            Unified Diagnostic Services   Standard protocol used for communication with service tools.
  UDP            User Datagram Protocol        UDP is one of the communication protocols of the Internet protocol(IP)  used to send messages (datagrams in packets) to other hosts on an Internet Protocol (IP) network. In an IP network, UDP does not require prior communication to set up communication channels or data paths.

  Abbreviation   Meaning                         Explanation
  -------------- ------------------------------- -------------

## X {#x .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  Abbreviation   Meaning                                                   Explanation
  -------------- --------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  XBAR           Crossbar Switch                                           The Crossbar Switch is a switching matrix that provides flexible connections between the various masters and slaves on the system bus.
  XCP            eXtended Universal Measurement and Calibration Protocol   Standard protocol used for transferring measurement data, e.g., debug information.
